h1: Used Tires in West Palm Beach
intro: Used tires in West Palm Beach are everyday work at Los Paisas Tires Shop, not a dusty corner we hide. The shop is at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. New tires are on the same floor, so you can compare a used casing with a new one before anyone mounts anything.

Used tires start from $65. The final price depends on size and on the tread that is actually left. Call (561) 429-4041 or come in between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM any day, including Sunday, and we will look up what we have for your car. Searching for used tires near me from Greenacres, Palm Springs, or Lake Worth Beach? Those areas are in Palm Beach County near this shop, and every used tire is checked here before it is sold.

sections.heading: What we check on a used tire
paragraphs: A used tire is only a bargain if it is the right size and the casing is still sound. Before we mount one, we look at the whole tire, not just the pretty part of the tread. If the sidewall is cracked, bubbled, or cut, that tire stays off your car. If the wear is cupped or one shoulder is gone, we tell you, because that pattern often means the old alignment or a worn part, not a tire you should trust for another season of Florida heat.

We also match the size and load rating to the vehicle. A tire that 'almost fits' is how people end up back in the bay. You can stand there and see the tire we are proposing. If we would not put it on a car we drive, we will not sell it to you as a quiet favor.

sections.heading: How a used-tire visit works
paragraphs: Call first if you know the size, or just bring the car. Hours are Monday through Sunday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. The team works in English and Spanish. We look at the tires that are on the car now, including the spare if that is the one that failed, and we say whether a used tire, a new tire, or a repair is the sensible job.

When you buy used tires from us, mounting and balancing are included in the price, which starts from $65 — no hidden fees added at the end. If the car pulls or the wear is diagonal, alignment is a separate service in the shop, not something we pretend a used tire will fix.
If you already bought tires somewhere else, that is a different job. We still mount customer-owned tires, but this page is about tires we sell from the shop.

sections.heading: Walk in, or call first
paragraphs: You do not need an appointment for used tires at Los Paisas Tires Shop. Walk-ins are welcome every day, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, including Sunday. Calling (561) 429-4041 first helps when you already know the size, so we can check stock before you drive in.

Payment at the shop is by credit card, debit card, or NFC tap. There is no online checkout for used tires on this site. The from-$65 figure is the starting point for used tires; the final price depends on size and remaining tread, and you hear that number before we mount anything.

sections.heading: Coming from nearby towns
paragraphs: There is one shop address: 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. Drivers from Greenacres, Palm Springs, and Lake Worth Beach use that same bay. Those three towns sit in Palm Beach County near the shop, so you can drive in when the tire will hold air. We do not quote a minute count, because traffic on Military Trl is not a promise.

If the car should not be driven, ask about mobile tire service instead of guessing. The van serves Palm Beach County from this address, and we confirm the spot by phone before anyone rolls. The van is not a second store, and it does not replace a full look through the used tires in the shop when you are choosing a set.

faqs.question: Do you sell new tires as well as used?
faqs.answer: Yes. Los Paisas Tires Shop at 1114 S Military Trl sells both. If a used tire is a poor match for the car, we say so and show you a new one.

faqs.question: Can I look at the used tire before you mount it?
faqs.answer: Yes. We want you to see the tread and the sidewalls. If you do not want that tire, we do not mount it.

faqs.question: What if you do not have my size today?
faqs.answer: Call (561) 429-4041 and ask. Stock moves. If we do not have it, we will tell you rather than stretch a tire that does not belong on the car.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment for used tires?
faqs.answer: No. Walk-ins are welcome at Los Paisas Tires Shop, 1114 S Military Trl, every day from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Calling (561) 429-4041 with your size first can save a trip if that size is out.

faqs.question: How can I pay for used tires?
faqs.answer: At the shop we accept cash, credit card, debit card, and NFC (contactless). Used tires start from $65; the exact price for your size is given before mounting.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing for used tires?
faqs.answer: Yes. Financing is available through Snap: fill out an online form and the credit decision usually takes about 15 minutes. Ask at Los Paisas Tires Shop, 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, or call (561) 429-4041.

faqs.question: Is mounting included when I buy a used tire?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you buy a tire from Los Paisas Tires Shop, mounting and balancing are included in the price. Used tires start from $65; the exact price for your size is confirmed before we mount.

faqs.question: How long does mounting a used tire usually take?
faqs.answer: Times are approximate and depend on how busy the shop is. A full set with alignment usually takes about 2 hours; a plug or puncture repair about 15–20 minutes; balancing about 15–20 minutes; alignment alone about 1 hour. Call (561) 429-4041 if you want a timing check before you pull in.

faqs.question: Do used tires come with a warranty?
faqs.answer: No. Used tires are sold without a warranty. We check each tire before we sell it and show you the tread and sidewalls. Call (561) 429-4041.

faqs.question: Are there extra fees on used tires?
faqs.answer: No. There are no extra fees. When you buy a used tire, mounting and balancing are included in the price from $65.
